remarks: Discover boutique-style living at Husted Commons, where timeless elegance meets contemporary design in a prime downtown New Canaan location, just 50 miles from NYC. Enjoy easy access to the Metro-North train station, Main and Elm streets, and a wide array of retail and dining options. This distinctive new complex built in 2024 features 12 residences, offering one-bedroom, two-bedroom, and two-bedroom loft options. The loft residences feature private rooftop decks. Each unique residence boasts open layouts that flood with natural light, soaring 9+ foot ceilings, and beautiful white oak flooring. Experience chef-inspired kitchens equipped with custom cabinetry, premium appliances, and quartz countertops. Master bedroom suites are designed for comfort, complemented by bathrooms with heated floors. Enjoy the benefits of smart home technology, in-residence washers and dryers, private security system, and custom solar shades for added convenience. Husted Commons also features elevator service, private balconies or terraces in select residences, reserved underground and courtyard parking for two cars with car charging stations, and inviting outdoor green spaces, making it the ideal choice for in-town living!
